alavani_thesis.label: Alavani et al. thesis reconstruction (fifteen PTX features; XGBoost and CatBoost), refit on the Ada calibration windows

planned_fit_windows.rule: the admitted windows of role fit of the same calibration document as our energy fit, same count; held-out windows excluded

alavani_thesis.reason: The thesis reconstruction cannot be set up faithfully for Ada from what the repository holds: it needs PTX and ptxas resource records compiled for sm_89 with the CUDA 13.2 toolchain of the Ada binaries, for every evaluation kernel and for the calibrator's energy fixtures, and none exists (only cubins, SASS and cuobjdump resource lines). The Blackwell PTX is sm_120 and its loop rules are fixed to that PTX's label numbering. Using the Blackwell-trained models, the Blackwell features or a different-toolchain compile of different code than the executed binaries would not be this method on this board. The compile-only step on Ada's host is a decision for the user.

also_needed: PTX of every evaluation kernel compiled for sm_89 with CUDA 13.2 (nvcc -ptx and -cubin -Xptxas -v, compile only, on Ada's host; none exists yet)
verified SM and memory clock rows for Ada (CUDA 13.2 removed the cudaDeviceProp clock fields, so the inventory cannot supply them; device_attributes refuses without them)

Mem_LD_shared_ns.packaged_calibration: constants.smem floor and slope (issue cost per request versus bank-conflict degree)

Mem_LD_uncoal_ns.packaged_calibration: no uncoalesced-load microbenchmark in the packaged calibrator

baseline_kernel_overhead_ns.flipflop_constant: fixed kernel overhead of its timing harness

idle_power.packaged_calibration: the packaged calibrator takes no idle-power window (its base power is a fitted intercept, not an idle measurement)

issue_cycles.packaged_calibration: constants.pipes (per-pipe issue cost); FlipFlop's single scalar is a different aggregate

max_power_fp.packaged_calibration: energy windows are mixed designs; no isolated maximum-activity run per component

max_power_mem.packaged_calibration: rd_dram / wr_dram windows are mixed with instruction issue

max_power_shm.packaged_calibration: shared16/shared64 windows are mixed with global loads

max_power_total.flipflop_constant: board power ceiling used as a clamp

power_alpha.packaged_calibration: needs a power sweep over active SM counts; none in the packaged calibrator

flipflop.label: FlipFlop (Rajput et al., ICSE 2026)
flipflop.reason: FlipFlop's time and power models read 22 calibration constants that come from its own calibration program. The packaged Ada calibration measures 1 of them under the same definition, has only a differently defined counterpart for 9, and has none for 12 (including idle power and the power-versus-active-SM-count law). Filling them from another board, from defaults or by a new fit would be a different method; running FlipFlop's own calibration on Ada would give it more calibration data than our model. So the row is not run on Ada.

removed_rows.accelwattch_style: AccelWattch is excluded from the executable comparison (BASELINE_CONTRACT.md, 3 October 2026); the earlier four-coefficient proxy is a reduced component model and is not a published baseline
removed_rows.alavani_refit: the ten-feature ridge adaptation is a historical adaptation, replaced by the thesis reconstruction (not run on Ada, see methods.alavani_thesis)

rules: same calibration windows as our model; nothing fitted or tuned on the evaluation cells; windows not admitted are excluded for every method alike
